findings.root_cause: Canonical decisions, evidence and one architecture guard were produced across earlier substeps without an owner-approved consolidation into Git.
findings.current_evidence: At the 12.17.6 entry, 126 pre-existing items and 11 Phase 12.17.5C evidence files were untracked; all 126 were classified and all were marked should_be_versioned.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Owner-approved exact disposition, 126/126 and 11/11 reconciled, all new 12.17.6/7 evidence included, no unexpected path staged, and final canonical evidence commit recorded without push.

findings.root_cause: Privacy-aware telemetry contracts exist, but no production composition root selects a persistent local sink or lifecycle policy.
findings.current_evidence: Sinks are instantiated only in tests, calibration defaults to a null sink, and startup/shutdown composition is absent.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Approved destination/retention choice and minimum signal matrix pass with no prompt, response, pedagogical content, secret, absolute path or raw exception persisted.

findings.root_cause: No HTTP server exists yet, so the required local-browser/loopback security policy has never been encoded as an executable invariant.
findings.current_evidence: No server, route, bind, CORS, cookie, CSRF, debug, host-header or OpenAPI surface is present.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Versioned loopback-only contract and architecture tests pass without adding a server or framework.

findings.root_cause: The sandbox policy has no concrete trusted resolver/inspector implementation.
findings.current_evidence: SandboxFilesystemPort documents the missing implementation; materialization_export is structural only.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Concrete local adapter remains behind the port and rejects traversal, links, races and undeclared output in targeted and integration tests.

findings.root_cause: SQLite runtime, semantic-index and backup file boundaries rely on inherited permissions and ordinary opens without a uniform no-follow policy.
findings.current_evidence: Core identity, checksum, read-only seed, migration and atomic-backup guards pass; explicit ACL/umask/owner and link checks are absent.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Seven SQLite hardening controls pass on temporary copies while the canonical seed remains byte-identical and no user database is touched.

findings.root_cause: Declared upper bounds do not freeze transitive artifacts or hashes.
findings.current_evidence: pyproject.toml and exact dev tool versions exist, but no resolved lock/hashes exist for runtime, calibration or development sets.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Reviewed hashed lock inputs reproduce a clean environment and the applicable validation commands pass.

findings.root_cause: Ignored test/output roots have no bounded retention procedure and repository-walking tests previously traversed nested copies.
findings.current_evidence: 3,134 .tmp files, 44 tool-cache files and 747 artifact files were observed; no stale file was proven.
findings.acceptance_evidence: Deterministic validation excludes ignored roots and a documented dry-run retention/cleanup command exists; deletion still requires explicit user authorization.
